scope: Make DRW_MLeader DWG encoding transactional across caller body, string, and handle buffers and test allocation-failure rollback with same-object retry.

changes: Wrap the existing MLEADER body encoder in encodeEntityDwgTransaction and pass its staged body, string, and handle buffers to the existing encoding path.
Keep output field order and validation unchanged; defer oType and caller-buffer commits until successful completion.
implementation.failureBehavior: Injected allocation failure leaves all caller streams and oType unchanged; retrying the same MLEADER against the same buffers matches clean output exactly.

validation.allocationSweep: PASS: 1,336 allocation offsets across HATCH and MPOLYGON at six DWG versions, plus MLEADER at AC1024/AC1027/AC1032; 75 entity/version/stream-layout profiles

coverage: The generated MLEADER includes style/entity handles and a root with a leader line and one point.
Five stream alias layouts are exercised: distinct streams, shared string/handle stream, body/string alias, body/handle alias, and all streams aliased.
Each allocation offset verifies body/string/handle bytes and bit positions, oType, and handle state, then performs same-object/same-buffer retry and exact comparison with clean output.
HATCH and MPOLYGON remain in the combined allocation sweep as regressions.
limitations: Generated transaction controls do not qualify MLEADER source-producer breadth, wire semantics, graph closure, or native annotation rendering.
No DWG or DXF drawing fixture was added.
